headline: Pakistan State-Owned Enterprises Post Rs342.8 Billion Loss in H1 FY26
summary: Pakistan's state-owned enterprises recorded an aggregate net loss of Rs342.8 billion during the first half of fiscal year 2026, according to the Prime Minister's adviser on privatisation.
why: State-owned enterprise losses represent a drain on Pakistan's national budget, necessitating fiscal subsidies and privatisations mandated by International Monetary Fund support programs.
